text:
Dallas is 12-6-2, 26 points from 20 games, and the week was about history and the future at once. Jamie Benn became only the second fifth-round pick ever to reach 1,000 NHL points, scoring the go-ahead goal against Buffalo to do it. A day later Jason Robertson, whose name has been floated in trade rumors (including one for Nikita Kucherov), won it in overtime against Florida.

This is a good team that has finished poorly. The Stars have 52.8% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) and 53% at five on five, yet they've scored 7.5 fewer goals than their chances deserve. The goaltending has made up for it, about 8 goals better than expected, with Jake Oettinger shutting out Buffalo twice this season. The best line has been Mikko Rantanen and Wyatt Johnston with Sam Steel, 62% of the chances, and Thomas Harley with Nils Lundkvist has outscored opponents 11-7 while carrying the minutes Miro Heiskanen's absence left behind. Harley played almost 31 minutes on Sunday.

The 8-3 loss in Winnipeg on Thursday was the outlier. Our simulations project 100 points and an 85% playoff chance. If the finishing catches up with the chances, that number has room to go up. Heiskanen's return is the thing to watch.
